notes.title: Improved deselecting pieces
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we just released a patch updating the game to v1.0.6 which will improves deselecting pieces.

Previously, you could deselect a piece only once all the moving/pushing animations have finished. This felt janky and unintuitive, especially when moving pieces at a faster pace and caused unwanted pushing when people wanted to select another piece.

Additionally, you can also deselect an already selected piece by clicking on it.

[h3]Did you know we released a SokoChess spin-off game?[/h3]
This update has been based on feedback we received from SokoChess White players. We updated this in both of the games.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2185860/SokoChess_White/

tags.feature: Additionally, you can also deselect an already selected piece by clicking on it.

notes.title: SokoChess Spin-off!
notes.content:
Imagine you sit down one day to play SokoChess but the black pieces don't show up. That's exactly what SokoChess White is about!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42333125/1f688778f2af3ec11017deef38c2ecfc14e85314.gif[/img]

You'll be pushing pieces again but this time they will your own! Instead of there being an opposing side playing against you, there will be many more various obstacles, some returning from the original SokoChess.

Once again you can look forward to 70 handcrafted levels, new twist to the Sokoban and Chess formula and last but not least a good quality of life features with new and additional improvements!

We hope you enjoy our new game and are looking forward to hearing your thoughts. We are expecting to release the demo by the end of January 2023, so stay tuned! 

Martin & Julieta

[h2]While you wait wishlist SokoChess White[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2185860/SokoChess_White/

notes.title: Demo update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, with the release closer than ever, we've updated the demo to better represent what the final game is going to play like.

On top of fixing minor bugs found in the previous demo version, we've improvement the polish and feel of the game. Eg: We removed the "You lost all your pieces" screen that would abruptly show up and could make it hard to see what exactly went wrong. Instead the undo and retry button will flash. 

We also added new setting options, to allow for further customizability of your experience. Eg: You can make the game background darker, you can toggle visible button hotkeys, etc.

Enjoy the improved demo!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1960400/SokoChess/
